title: Cheetah (Acinonyx jubatus) purring and calling its brother from a road marker
author: Bernard DUPONT
changes: Wild cheetah (Acinonyx jubatus) in Kruger National Park calling its brother: a stuttering purr followed by two bird-like chirps. Trimmed to 13.60–16.52 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 0.2 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Audio track of the video.
